characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young, determined man with an average build and youthful appearance. His hair is unkempt, reflecting his humble origins. He is often seen wearing simple, worn clothing suited to a lower-class lifestyle. Key features include his resourcefulness, exemplified by his carrying a large wooden kneading trough on his journey. He conveys a sense of humble ambition and quiet charisma, which earns him affection in the royal kitchen despite modest beginnings.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: Troldet is a menacing, large creature with a daunting presence. It's depicted living across the water from the royal palace, often seeking to protect its treasures like the seven silver ducks and a magical gold and silver bedspread. Troldet has a grotesque, mythical appearance with rough, rocky skin and fierce eyes that betray its malicious intent.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: Trolddatteren is the Troll's daughter, featuring the same rugged and mythical traits as her father but with a more distinct feminine touch. Her presence is marked by an air of obedient malignity, tasked with carrying out Troldet's orders. She is eventually outwitted by Askeladden.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen is a regal figure, dressed in finery befitting his royal status. He commands authority through a stern yet fair demeanor, reflecting the burdens of kingship. His appearance is characterized by rich robes, a crown, and a courteous presence.

characters.name: Kongsdatteren
characters.description: Kongsdatteren, the princess, exudes grace and elegance, embodying the beauty and charm typical of fairy tale royalty. She is adorned in flowing, regal attire, often in vibrant colors symbolizing her noble heritage. Her demeanor is gentle yet regal, befitting her role as both a prize and partner in Askeladden's quest.
